name: 2.0.0-test-rc6 release checklist
description: Acceptance checks for the 2.0.0-test-rc6 release candidate.

items.name: Release identity
items.description: Dashboard, API, image, and OpenClaw versions match the release candidate.

items.name: Plugin navigation and sidebar
items.description: Compact labels remain readable and the sidebar never falls onto a white page background.

items.name: Public plugin host
items.description: Plugin index, diagnostics, navigation, and workspace pages agree on enabled public plugins.

items.name: Private plugin image
items.description: The private image loads only its intended plugin inventory from locked source commits.

items.name: Guardrails suggestions and targeting
items.description: Suggested guardrails can be selected, customized, and assigned to agents and workflows.

items.name: Evals suggestions and runs
items.description: Suggested evals can be customized and run with visible progress, score, token, and cost results.

items.name: AI Create quality scoring
items.description: Guardrail and eval creation show a public quality score with useful suggestions before saving.

items.name: Plugin relationship views
items.description: Grid, detail, list, and relationship views show selected items and their agent or workflow targets.

items.name: Plugin lifecycle notifications
items.description: Eval completion and guardrail activation or deactivation produce useful notifications and history.

items.name: Optimize plugin skeleton
items.description: The public Optimize plugin loads and supports draft workflow or agent budget recommendations.

items.name: Restart persistence
items.description: Checklist results, plugin discovery, workspace records, and OpenClaw state survive restart.

items.name: Responsive plugin operations
items.description: Plugin forms, suggested items, checklist actions, views, and details remain usable on phone and desktop.

items.name: Automated regression suite
items.description: Local validation, coverage, and multi-architecture image CI are green.
